messages:
bench-bot: perf-regression alert: eval-suite 'long-context-coherence' failure rate jumped from 0.8% -> 7.1% for Mixtral-7B variant (canary).

maria-ml: saw the alert. repro is consistent on nightly eval harness. not a data drift signal — outputs are syntactically weird mid-way through long prompts.

kai-runtime: I'm seeing a sharp divergence when the kernel selector picks the tiled attention path at seq_len > 1024. profiler snapshot attached in thread — high KV eviction churn and a sudden drop in cache hit rate.

sam-eng: curious — tiled path was enabled via selector change in commit 9f3a2c1 last night (heuristic: prefer tiled for mixtral when seq >= 1024 and head_dim % 64 == 0).

jordan-eng-ml: example from eval that fails (truncated):
```
Input: <long doc> ... prompt continues > 1200 tokens
Expected: consistent persona reply
Observed: mid-response token repetition + context jump to unrelated topic
```
Also saw attention scores collapse for some heads around token 1120.

kai-runtime: profiler snippet:
```
[profile] kernel_selector -> tiled_attn (mixtral, seq=1280)
[kv_cache] evict_rate: 0.47 -> 0.90 (post-change)
[batcher] mean_batch: 1.2 -> 3.8 (latency SLO unaffected)
[kernel] perf: tiled_attn throughput +18% but kv_access_latency +220us
```
Suggests tiled_attn is faster raw but causes KV cache pressure leading to correctness issues (maybe stale KV indexing or alignment).

sam-eng: the tiled implementation uses a packed KV layout for vectorized heads; I wonder if head/kv dim packing assumptions changed. Mixtral's head_dim is 128, which should be fine, but the tiled code assumes contiguous per-head layout vs runtime's interleaved layout for some quantized variants.

maria-ml: that would explain quality: if KV addressing is off by a head stride, attention mixes wrong positions -> collapsed attention. Any repro that forces non-tiled path?

kai-runtime: yes — forcing `kernel_selector.force=unoptimized` on the canary removes the regression; eval failure rate drops to 0.9%. quick patch: add a runtime guard to skip tiled_attn for Mixtral-7B until we confirm layout assumptions.

lee-sre: we have a canary group still at 8% traffic. Recommend scaling that down and rolling the change back on canary to limit blast radius while we investigate. Ops: rolling back commit 9f3a2c1 for canary only is trivial via rollout controller.

sam-eng: will do a quick bisect to confirm the exact code path: suspect lines in tiled_attn allocator: `kv_stride = head_dim / tile_factor` vs expected `kv_stride = head_dim * head_pack`. If confirmed I'll add assertion and a compatibility check.

jordan-eng-ml: also running evals with attention logging enabled — attaching per-head attention norm plots to the ticket. Heads 3/4/11 show repeated near-identical vectors after seq ~1100 when tiled path active.

kai-runtime: plan: (1) flip runtime guard to prefer scalar/kern for Mixtral-7B (hotfix), (2) bisect tiled_attn allocator layout and add unit tests that assert kv addressing across varied packing, (3) re-run full eval suite and run stress with seq 2k, batch sizes 1..8, quantized and fp16 variants.

maria-ml: +1. also add a small regression test in eval harness that ensures attention continuity (no abrupt head collapse) for long prompts. if tests catch this in CI we avoid future silent swaps.

lee-sre: action items assigned. I'll start the canary rollback in 2m and monitor customer-facing latencies. update thread when rollback finishes. :eyes:

bench-bot: rollback started by lee-sre at 2034567915.

lee-sre: rollback complete at 2034567925. canary health -> green, eval failures dropped to baseline. leaving this open for the debug pr and test additions.

maria-ml: thanks all — please file the follow-up PRs and tag me for eval changes. We'll schedule a postmortem-lite if root cause is layout assumption mismatch.
